Layout xaxis rangeselector button objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_xaxis_rangeselector_button.Rd

Sets the specifications for each buttons. By default, a range selector comes with no buttons. The object for an element of the buttons list of the layout's xaxis.rangeselector (go_xaxis_rangeselector()). go_xaxis_rangeselector_button() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_xaxis_rangeselector_button(
  ...,
  count = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  step = NULL,
  stepmode = NULL,
  templateitemname = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

count

Sets the number of steps to take to update the range. Use with `step` to specify the update interval. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

label

Sets the text label to appear on the button. String.

name

When used in a template, named items are created in the output figure in addition to any items the figure already has in this array. You can modify these items in the output figure by making your own item with `templateitemname` matching this `name` alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). Has no effect outside of a template. String.

step

The unit of measurement that the `count` value will set the range by. One of "month", "year", "day", "hour", "minute", "second", "all".

stepmode

Sets the range update mode. If "backward", the range update shifts the start of range back "count" times "step" milliseconds. If "todate", the range update shifts the start of range back to the first timestamp from "count" times "step" milliseconds back. For example, with `step` set to "year" and `count` set to 1 the range update shifts the start of the range back to January 01 of the current year. Month and year "todate" are currently available only for the built-in (Gregorian) calendar. One of "backward", "todate".

templateitemname

Used to refer to a named item in this array in the template. Named items from the template will be created even without a matching item in the input figure, but you can modify one by making an item with `templateitemname` matching its `name`, alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). If there is no template or no matching item, this item will be hidden unless you explicitly show it with `visible: true`. String.

visible

Determines whether or not this button is visible. Logical.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_layout_xaxis_rangeselector_button object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, mode = "markers") |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis = go_xaxis(
      rangeselector = go_xaxis_rangeselector(
        buttons = list(go_xaxis_rangeselector_button(visible = TRUE))
      )
    )
  )
